item.title: 【HD Live Performances】HDTV - Top & Pop Christmas Music Videos / Los Mejores Vídeos Musicales Navideños
item.description:
Top & Pop Christmas Music Videos is a compilation of the main Christmas videos according to the rankings of the main music streaming applications and others, where we will find the main classic, modern and popular Christmas songs.

The presentation is based on the main rankings where additional videos have been interspersed to maintain the rhythm between classic and modern.

La presentación esta basada en los principales rankings donde se han intercalado videos adicionales para mantener el ritmo entre lo clásico y moderno.
